title: Passenger | Infant Without Seat | Not Eligible | Adult Eligible | Mixed Result | Compensation for Adult Only
description:
PNR has 1 adult + 1 infant without seat (lap infant). Adult is eligible for compensation. Infant is NOT eligible under APPR. System must display clear messaging about infant ineligibility and create compensation record for adult only. Per call transcript: "Infants are not eligible for compensation in flight disruption scenarios."

Prerequisites:
PNR: TCED14; 2 passengers: Sarah Miller (Adult) + Baby Miller (Infant, DOB: Jan 2025, no seat assigned); 1 leg AC (YUL?YYZ); Delay 4 hrs; Code 42; APPR
